title: Skeptical Finnish ROV team calls it man-made and like a power line
summary: Dennis Asberg tells of Skeptical Finnish ROV team calls it man-made and like a power line, about 2019 at Baltic Sea anomaly, between Sweden and Finland, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: This must be man-made. This is constructed."

plain: A Swedish treasure hunter named Dennis Asberg says that in 2019 a skeptical Finnish team sent an ROV, a remotely operated underwater robot, down to the Baltic Sea anomaly, a strange shape his team found on the seafloor between Sweden and Finland. According to Asberg, the Finnish operator concluded, "This must be man-made. This is constructed," and compared part of it to a power line. If true, it would mean even doubters saw the object as built rather than natural.
